plugins.name: Apple Motion Artwork
plugins.description: Animated album covers from Apple Music, rendered behind the now-playing view.

description_i18n.fr: Pochettes d'album animées depuis Apple Music, affichées derrière la vue En cours de lecture.
description_i18n.de: Animierte Albumcover aus Apple Music, hinter der Ansicht „Wird gespielt“ dargestellt.
description_i18n.es: Portadas de álbum animadas de Apple Music, mostradas detrás de la vista Reproduciendo ahora.
description_i18n.it: Copertine animate degli album da Apple Music, mostrate dietro la vista In riproduzione.

description_i18n.ru: Анимированные обложки альбомов из Apple Music, отображаемые позади экрана «Сейчас играет».
description_i18n.tr: Apple Music'ten animasyonlu albüm kapakları, Şimdi çalıyor görünümünün arkasında gösterilir.
description_i18n.id: Sampul album animasi dari Apple Music, ditampilkan di belakang tampilan Sedang diputar.

description_i18n.hi: Apple Music से एनिमेटेड एल्बम कवर, "अब चल रहा है" व्यू के पीछे दिखाए जाते हैं।
